entities.summary: Stanislav Sventek was an ice hockey player who played for the Czechoslovak national team. He won a bronze medal at the 1964 Winter Olympics. He also won a silver medal at 1961 Ice Hockey World Championships and bronze medals at 1957 and 1963 Ice Hockey World Championships.
